description: Unique stable lowercase slug identifying the model; one row per model.
Common name or acronym of the model.
Original developers of the model (individuals); separate multiple names with ';'. Leave blank if not known.
Individuals or organizations that added to the model's later development; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.
Organization(s) that supported or directed the model's development; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.

Species or species groups covered; separate multiple values with ';'. Use expanded lists instead of Eastern SPF or Western SPF. A general summary only; see the model's own documentation for the authoritative list.
example: Balsam fir;black spruce;red spruce;white spruce;jack pine

description: Minimum inputs needed to initialize or run the model; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.
Other features the model represents (e.g. mortality; regeneration; climate; disturbance); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.
Programming language(s) the model is written in; separate multiple values with ';'. Use unknown until determined.
How the model itself can be obtained. Use unknown until determined.
How users run the model; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.
Standardized output categories used by the catalogue filter; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known; keep detail in 'outputs'.
Management actions the model can represent (e.g. thinning; fertilization; pruning); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not known.

Stands the model is intended for: unmanaged = natural-origin or fire-origin stands, or stands harvested long ago and now old; managed = stands that have been harvested or replanted (e.g. after harvest or fire); unmanaged_managed = both. Use unknown until determined.
Free-text qualifications or uncertainties. Do not guess values.
Date the maintainer last reviewed this model's entry.
